title: Creation
description: The famous four-line "Creation by Silexars" shader, alive and tweakable. Three time-offset slices of a radial ripple field — one per colour channel — are pushed through a mod() lattice, so the whole plane fills with concentric travelling waves that bloom, split into RGB fringes and wash across each other. Speed, per-channel offset, ripple frequency, tiling and brightness are live params; loudness speeds the ripples and beats brighten them. Original by Danilo Guanabara, adapted to WebGL2.
